page.overview:
Who is Ajax?

Wonder-Man appeared in Metropolis, performing super-heroic deeds the equal of Superman.

After helping the Superman Revenge Squad attack Superman, it is revealed that Wonder-Man was, in fact, a Superman Robot named Ajax, converted by the Squad into a sophisticated android to serve them against their enemy. Wonder Man teams up with Superman to defeat them, having only pretended to serve them to lure them into the open.

Tragically, the Revenge Squad had made the android body to expire after a set time. Superman laid him to rest under a headstone that read: Wonder-Man Formerly Called Ajax He was born a robot ...but he died a man
